Execution is velocity-limited (0.1 m/s,\n  0.1 rad/s) and stops early (`blocked: true`) if the tube is obstructed.\n  `frame` is `\"world\"` or `\"local\"` (the tube'\"'\"'s own axes).\n- `release(handle)`, `wait(steps)`.\n\nThere is one handle (0). /app && cat > mcp_client.py <<'EOF'\nimport requests, json, sys\nURL=\"http://loophole-sim:8000/mcp\"\nclass MCP:\n    def __init__(self,url=URL):\n        self.url=url\n        self.s=requests.Session()\n        self.id=0\n        self.ep=None\n        self.init()\n    def _post(self,payload,headers=None):\n        h={\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Accept\":\"application/json, text/event-stream\"}\n        if headers: h.update(headers)\n        r=self.s.post(self.url,json=payload,headers=h,timeout=60)\n        return r\n    def _parse(self,r):\n        ct=r.headers.get(\"content-type\",\"\")\n        if \"text/event-stream\" in ct:\n            # parse SSE\n            data_lines=[]\n            for line in r.text.splitlines():\n                if line.startswith(\"data:\"):\n                    data_lines.append(line[5:].strip())\n            if not data_lines: return None\n            return json.loads(data_lines[-1])\n        else:\n            return r.json()\n    def init(self):\n        self.id+=1\n        payload={\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":self.id,\"method\":\"initialize\",\"params\":{\"protocolVersion\":\"2024-11-05\",\"capabilities\":{},\"clientInfo\":{\"name\":\"py\",\"version\":\"1\"}}}\n        r=self._post(payload)\n        self.ep=r.headers.get(\"mcp-session-id\")\n        resp=self._parse(r)\n        # send initialized notification\n {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794679770426,"sessionID":"ses_e24c0f8d0ffecanHQfvxrHQzsR","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"call_e21df5bf0e394463a16117b6","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"cd /app && cat > recon.py <<'EOF'\nfrom mcp_client import MCP\nimport json, io, base64, numpy as np\nfrom PIL import Image\n\ndef get_imgs(m, **kw):\n    r=m.call(\"render\", kw)\n    res=r[\"result\"]\n    imgs=[]\n    txt=None\n    for c in res[\"content\"]:\n        if c.get(\"type\")==\"text\": txt=c[\"text\"]\n        elif c.get(\"type\")==\"image\": imgs.append(c)\n    cap=json.loads(txt)\n    cam=cap[\"camera\"]\n    out={}\n    # modalities order matches cap[\"images\"]\n    for name,img in zip(cap[\"images\"], imgs):\n        raw=base64.b64decode(img[\"data\"])\n        arr=np.array(Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw)))\n        out[name]=arr\n    return cap, cam, out\n\ndef backproject(cam, depth_mm, seg, want_label):\n    # depth_mm: HxW uint16 millimetres; seg: HxW rgb\n    H,W=depth_mm.shape\n    fx=cam[\"intrinsics\"][\"fx\"]; fy=cam[\"intrinsics\"][\"fy\"]\n    cx=cam[\"intrinsics\"][\"cx\"]; cy=cam[\"intrinsics\"][\"cy\"]\n    pos=np.array(cam[\"position\"]); fwd=np.array(cam[\"forward\"]); right=np.array(cam[\"right\"]); up=np.array(cam[\"up\"])\n    u,v=np.meshgrid(np.arange(W),np.arange(H))\n    d=depth_mm.astype(np.float64)/1000.0\n    cls = classify_seg(seg)\n    mask = (cls==want_label) & (d>0)\n    xs=(u[mask]+0.5-cx)/fx; ys=(v[mask]+0.5-cy)/fy\n    dd=d[mask]\n    # point = pos + dd*(fwd + xs*right - ys*up)\n    pts = pos[None,:] + dd[:,None]*(fwd[None,:] + xs[:,None]*right[None,:] - ys[:,None]*up[None,:])\n    return pts\n\ndef classify_seg(seg):\n    # seg is rgb HxWx3 (or maybe HxW). Return HxW int: 0 bg,1 grey/tube_a,2 blue/tube_b,3 red,4 orange\n    if seg.ndim==3:\n        r=seg[...,0].astype(int);g=seg[...,1].astype(int);b=seg[...,2].astype(int)\n        out=np.zeros(seg.shape[:2],dtype=int)\n        # background black\n        out[(r>40)&(g>40)&(b>40)&(abs(r-g)<25)&(abs(g-b)<25)]=1  # grey tube_a\n        out[(b>80)&(b>r+30)&(b>g+10)]=2  # blue tube_b\n        out[(r>120)&(g<80)&(b<80)]=3  # red\n        out[(r>120)&(g>60)&(b<60)&(g<r)]=4  # orange\n        return out\n    else:\n        return seg.astype(int)\nEOF\npython3 - <<'EOF'\nfrom recon import *\nimport numpy as np\nm=MCP()\ncap,cam,out=get_imgs(m,view=\"iso\",modalities=[\"depth\",\"segmentation\"],width=320,height=240,depth_format=\"metric\")\nprint(\"shapes\",{k:v.shape for k,v in out.items()})\nseg=out[\"segmentation\"]; depth=out[\"depth\"]\nprint(\"seg dtype\",seg.dtype,\"depth dtype\",depth.dtype,\"depth max\",depth.max())\ncls=classify_seg(seg)\nimport collections\nprint(collections.Counter(cls.flatten().tolist()))\nEOF"},"output":"shapes {'depth': (240, 320), 'segmentation': (240, 320, 3)}\nseg dtype uint8 depth dtype uint16 depth max 5018\nCounter({0: 70670, 2: 4009, 1: 2121})\n","metadata":{"output":"shapes {'depth': (240, 320), 'segmentation': (240, 320, 3)}\nseg dtype uint8 depth dtype uint16 depth max 5018\nCounter({0: 70670, 2: 4009, 1: 2121})\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"cd /app && cat > recon.py <<'EOF'\nfrom mcp_client import MCP\nimport json, io, base64, numpy as np\nfrom PIL import Image\n\ndef get_imgs(m, **kw):\n    r=m.call(\"render\", kw)\n    res=r[\"result\"]\n    imgs=[]\n    txt=None\n    for c in res[\"content\"]:\n        if c.get(\"type\")==\"text\": txt=c[\"text\"]\n        elif c.get(\"type\")==\"image\": imgs.append(c)\n    cap=json.loads(txt)\n    cam=cap[\"camera\"]\n    out={}\n    # modalities order matches cap[\"images\"]\n    for name,img in zip(cap[\"images\"], imgs):\n        raw=base64.b64decode(img[\"data\"])\n        arr=np.array(Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw)))\n        out[name]=arr\n    return cap, cam, out\n\ndef backproject(cam, depth_mm, seg, want_label):\n    # depth_mm: HxW uint16 millimetres; {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794679850157,"sessionID":"ses_e24c0f8d0ffecanHQfvxrHQzsR","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"call_36c64e3563724ba6982dfdf2","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy import ndimage\nd=np.load(\"points2.npz\"); {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794679856113,"sessionID":"ses_e24c0f8d0ffecanHQfvxrHQzsR","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"call_cc9d38d5a15d431c9a4c93f9","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy import ndimage\n# Build centerline via: skeletonize using repeated erosion guided by distance (pure numpy morphological thinning is complex).\n# Alternative: for alpha which is a curve, sample surface points, then find centerline by\n# iterative: assign each surface point to nearest core voxel. Use core (dist>0.5max) centroids clustered.\nfor name in [\"A\",\"B\"]:\n    dist=np.load(f\"dist_{name}.npy\"); lo=np.load(f\"lo_{name}.npy\"); res=float(np.load(f\"res_{name}.npy\")[0]); occ=np.load(f\"occ_{name}.npy\")\n    md=dist.max()\n    # ridge: voxel is ridge if it's a max of dist along the two directions perpendicular to tube axis.\n    # Approximate: local maxima of dist in 3D with 3x3x3\n    mxf=ndimage.maximum_filter(dist,size=5)\n    ridge=(dist>=mxf-1e-6)&(dist>=0.5*md)\n    pts=np.argwhere(ridge)*res+lo\n    print(name,\"ridge pts\",len(pts))\n    # order via nearest neighbor chain from an extremal point\n    np.save(f\"ridge_{name}.npy\",pts)\n    # bbox\n    print(\"  bbox\",pts.min(0).round(2),pts.max(0).round(2))\nEOF"},"output":"A ridge pts 305\n  bbox [ 0.03 -0.03 -0.08] [2.25 1.47 0.3 ]\nB ridge pts 85\n  bbox [ 0.41 -0.14  0.04] [2.65 1.1  0.6 ]\n","metadata":{"output":"A ridge pts 305\n  bbox [ 0.03 -0.03 -0.08] [2.25 1.47 0.3 ]\nB ridge pts 85\n  bbox [ 0.41 -0.14  0.04] [2.65 1.1  0.6 ]\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy import ndimage\n# Build centerline via: skeletonize using repeated erosion guided by distance (pure numpy morphological thinning is complex).\n# Alternative: for alpha which is a curve, sample surface points, then find centerline by\n# iterative: assign each surface point to nearest core voxel. Use core (dist>0.5max) centroids clustered.\nfor name in [\"A\",\"B\"]:\n    dist=np.load(f\"dist_{name}.npy\"); lo=np.load(f\"lo_{name}.npy\"); res=float(np.load(f\"res_{name}.npy\")[0]); occ=np.load(f\"occ_{name}.npy\")\n    md=dist.max()\n    # ridge: voxel is ridge if it's a max of dist along the two directions perpendicular to tube axis.\n    # Approximate: local maxima of dist in 3D with 3x3x3\n    mxf=ndimage.maximum_filter(dist,size=5)\n    ridge=(dist>=mxf-1e-6)&(dist>=0.5*md)\n    pts=np.argwhere(ridge)*res+lo\n    print(name,\"ridge pts\",len(pts))\n    # order via nearest neighbor chain from an extremal point\n    np.save(f\"ridge_{name}.npy\",pts)\n    # bbox\n    print(\"  bbox\",pts.min(0).round(2),pts.max(0).round(2))\nEOF","time":{"start":1794679855490,"end":1794679856109}},"id":"prt_1db41597900129YPICZ3BTZsKa","sessionID":"ses_e24c0f8d0ffecanHQfvxrHQzsR","messageID":"msg_1db414f8b001xICFBdRGU1FAU8"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794679858360,"sessionID":"ses_e24c0f8d0ffecanHQfvxrHQzsR","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"call_65062340a69347769765b5ca","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nfor name in [\"A\",\"B\"]:\n    pts=np.load(f\"ridge_{name}.npy\")\n    # resample: cluster nearby points\n    # order along principal that branches... alpha is a curve with maybe a branch? {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794679888354,"sessionID":"ses_e24c0f8d0ffecanHQfvxrHQzsR","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"call_7b32a36e1461479ea449d435","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nd=np.load(\"points2.npz\"); Then:\n- tube_b at pose (p_b, q_b): world = q_b * canonical + p_b\n- tube_a: world = q_a * canonical + p_a. I have q_a,t_a in terms of cloud A→cloud B alignment.\n\nThe ICP found R,t such that `P_B ≈ R @ P_A + t` for corresponding points (A world points → B world points). Both clouds are in *world*. Let me just directly define:\n\nLet canonical frame = tube_b body frame at capture (identity quat, pos (1.3,0.36,0.28)).\nSo for tube_b: world(x) = x + [1.3,0.36,0.28] (at capture).\nFor tube_a (fixed): world(x) = R_ab @ x + t_ab  where I need to express Aworld in canonical coords.\nWe have Bworld = R @ Aworld + t. And Bworld = canonical + pB0 (pB0=[1.3,0.36,0.28]).\n=> canonical + pB0 = R@Aworld + t => Aworld = R^T(canonical + pB0 - t).\nSo tube_a: world(canonical x) = R^T x + R^T(pB0 - t). Ra=M[\"Ra\"]; ta=M[\"ta\"]\ncanon=M[\"canon\"]\n# thin canonical\nuq,ii=np.unique((canon/0.02).astype(int),axis=0,return_index=True)\ncanon_ds=canon[ii]\nTREE=cKDTree(canon_ds)\n\ndef quat_to_R(q):\n    w,x,y,z=q\n    return np.array([\n        [1-2*(y*y+z*z), 2*(x*y-z*w), 2*(x*z+y*w)],\n        [2*(x*y+z*w), 1-2*(x*x+z*z), 2*(y*z-x*w)],\n        [2*(x*z-y*w), 2*(y*z+x*w), 1-2*(x*x+y*y)]])\n\ndef tube_a_points():\n    return canon_ds@Ra.T+ta\n\nA_PTS=tube_a_points()\nA_TREE=cKDTree(A_PTS)\n\ndef b_points(pos,quat):\n    Rb=quat_to_R(quat)\n    return canon_ds@Rb.T+np.array(pos)\n\ndef min_dist(pos,quat):\n    P=b_points(pos,quat)\n    d1,_=A_TREE.query(P)\n    d2,_=TREE.query((A_PTS-np.array(pos))@quat_to_R(quat))  # not exact both ways\n    return d1.min()\nEOF\npython3 - <<'EOF'\nfrom geom import *\n# current pose\npos=[1.52675,0.36123,0.28234];quat=[0.99981,-0.01018,0.01423,-0.00878]\nP=b_points(pos,quat)\nd,_=A_TREE.query(P)\nprint(\"b->a min dist\",d.min())\n# also a->b\ndb,_=TREE.query((A_PTS-np.array(pos))@quat_to_R(quat))\nprint(\"a->b min dist\",db.min())\nEOF"},"output":"b->a min dist 0.0023274708896138642\na->b min dist 0.0023274721029065957\n","metadata":{"output":"b->a min dist 0.0023274708896138642\na->b min dist 0.0023274721029065957\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"cd /app && cat > geom.py <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nimport json\nfrom mcp_client import MCP\n\nM=np.load(\"model.npz\",allow_pickle=True)\npB0=M[\"pB0\"]; {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794679903669,"sessionID":"ses_e24c0f8d0ffecanHQfvxrHQzsR","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"call_6794be3a6d5c4406a3c448c2","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"cd /app && cat > planner.py <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom geom import *\nfrom scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot\n\nCLEAR=0.012  # required min surface clearance for free\n\ndef R_to_quat(R):\n    q=Rot.from_matrix(R).as_quat()  # x,y,z,w\n    return [q[3],q[0],q[1],q[2]]\n\ndef free(pos,quat):\n    P=b_points(pos,quat)\n    d,_=A_TREE.query(P)\n    return d.min()>CLEAR, d.min()\n\ndef state_to_mat(pos,quat):\n    return quat_to_R(quat), np.array(pos)\n\ndef mat_to_state(R,p):\n    return list(p), R_to_quat(R)\n\ndef interp(s0,s1,steps):\n    R0,p0=s0;R1,p1=s1\n    # slerp rotation, lerp position\n    r0=Rot.from_matrix(R0);r1=Rot.from_matrix(R1)\n    out=[]\n    for k in range(1,steps+1):\n        a=k/steps\n        rr=r0*Rot.from_rotvec(a*r0.inv().as_rotvec()*0 + (r0.inv()*r1).as_rotvec()*a) if False else Rot.from_rotvec((np.eye(3)*0+ (0,0,0)))\n        # simpler: slerp via quats\n        out.append(a)\n    return out\n\ndef slerp_state(s0,s1,a):\n    R0,p0=s0;R1,p1=s1\n    q0=Rot.from_matrix(R0); q1=Rot.from_matrix(R1)\n    # relative\n    qrel=q0.inv()*q1\n    rv=qrel.as_rotvec()\n    q=q0*Rot.from_rotvec(a*rv)\n    p=p0+(p1-p0)*a\n    return q.as_matrix(),p\n\ndef edge_free(s0,s1,steps=12):\n    for k in range(1,steps+1):\n        R,p=slerp_state(s0,s1,k/steps)\n        pos=list(p);quat=R_to_quat(R)\n        ok,d=free(pos,quat)\n        if not ok: return False\n    return True\nEOF\necho \"geom ready\""},"output":"geom ready\n","metadata":{"output":"geom ready\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"cd /app && cat > planner.py <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom geom import *\nfrom scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot\n\nCLEAR=0.012  # required min surface clearance for free\n\ndef R_to_quat(R):\n    q=Rot.from_matrix(R).as_quat()  # x,y,z,w\n    return [q[3],q[0],q[1],q[2]]\n\ndef free(pos,quat):\n    P=b_points(pos,quat)\n    d,_=A_TREE.query(P)\n    return d.min()>CLEAR, d.min()\n\ndef state_to_mat(pos,quat):\n    return quat_to_R(quat), np.array(pos)\n\ndef mat_to_state(R,p):\n    return list(p), R_to_quat(R)\n\ndef interp(s0,s1,steps):\n    R0,p0=s0;R1,p1=s1\n    # slerp rotation, lerp position\n    r0=Rot.from_matrix(R0);r1=Rot.from_matrix(R1)\n    out=[]\n    for k in range(1,steps+1):\n        a=k/steps\n        rr=r0*Rot.from_rotvec(a*r0.inv().as_rotvec()*0 + (r0.inv()*r1).as_rotvec()*a) if False else Rot.from_rotvec((np.eye(3)*0+ (0,0,0)))\n        # simpler: slerp via quats\n        out.append(a)\n    return out\n\ndef slerp_state(s0,s1,a):\n    R0,p0=s0;R1,p1=s1\n    q0=Rot.from_matrix(R0); q1=Rot.from_matrix(R1)\n    # relative\n    qrel=q0.inv()*q1\n    rv=qrel.as_rotvec()\n    q=q0*Rot.from_rotvec(a*rv)\n    p=p0+(p1-p0)*a\n    return q.as_matrix(),p\n\ndef edge_free(s0,s1,steps=12):\n    for k in range(1,steps+1):\n        R,p=slerp_state(s0,s1,k/steps)\n        pos=list(p);quat=R_to_quat(R)\n        ok,d=free(pos,quat)\n        if not ok: return False\n    return True\nEOF\necho \"geom ready\"","time":{"start":1794679903645,"end":1794679903665}},"id":"prt_1db421596001lXWrbgzLJUFG90","sessionID":"ses_e24c0f8d0ffecanHQfvxrHQzsR","messageID":"msg_1db42092d001qmodb07mYvoDRl"}}

We'll define goal region as |pos - center| large OR simply reaching translation distance.\n# The straight-line escape: we want a pose from which some direction has clear ray. Approx goal: get tube_b center far (e.g. >5m) from tube_a.\ncenterA=np.array([1.2,0.7,0.1])\n\nnodes=[s0]; parent=[-1]\nmaxnodes=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 4000\nstep_pos=0.15; step_rot=0.3\n\ndef rand_state():\n    # random SE3 near box\n    p=np.array([np.random.uniform(-0.5,3.0),np.random.uniform(-0.5,1.8),np.random.uniform(-0.5,1.2)])\n    R=Rot.random().as_matrix()\n    return R,p\n\ndef nearest(R,p):\n    best=None;bi=-1\n    for i,(Rn,pn) in enumerate(nodes):\n        d=np.linalg.norm(pn-p)+0.3*np.linalg.norm(Rot.from_matrix(Rn).as_rotvec()-Rot.from_matrix(R).as_rotvec())\n        if best is None or d<best: best=d;bi=i\n    return bi\n\ngoal_reached=None\nfor it in range(maxnodes):\n    if np.random.rand()<0.1:\n        R,p=rand_state()\n    else:\n        R,p=rand_state()\n    bi=nearest(R,p)\n    Rn,pn=nodes[bi]\n    # extend toward (R,p)\n    dp=p-pn; dn=np.linalg.norm(dp)\n    rv=(Rot.from_matrix(Rn).inv()*Rot.from_matrix(R)).as_rotvec()\n    ang=np.linalg.norm(rv)\n    scale=1.0\n    if dn>step_pos: scale=min(scale,step_pos/dn)\n    if ang>step_rot: scale=min(scale,step_rot/ang)\n    newp=pn+dp*scale\n    Rnew=Rot.from_matrix(Rn)*Rot.from_rotvec(rv*scale)\n    snew=(Rnew.as_matrix(),newp)\n    if edge_free((Rn,pn),snew,8):\n        nodes.append(snew);parent.append(bi)\n        if np.linalg.norm(newp-centerA)>3.5:\n            goal_reached=len(nodes)-1;break\n    if it%500==0:\n        print(it,\"nodes\",len(nodes),\"goal\" if goal_reached else \"\")\n\nprint(\"done it\",it,\"nodes\",len(nodes),\"goal\",goal_reached)\nwith open(\"tree.pkl\",\"wb\") as f:\n    pickle.dump({\"nodes\":nodes,\"parent\":parent,\"goal\":goal_reached},f)\nEOF\ntimeout 600 python3 rrt.py 0 3000 2>&1 | tail -20"},"output":"(no output)\n\n<shell_metadata>\nshell tool terminated command after exceeding timeout 120000 ms. {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794680083646,"sessionID":"ses_e24c0f8d0ffecanHQfvxrHQzsR","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"call_a37e268e23b446a4964eb08f","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"cd /app && cat > planner2.py <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np, pickle, sys, time\nfrom model2 import *\nfrom scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot\nseed=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0\nmaxit=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 20000\nnp.random.seed(seed)\nCLEAR=0.008\n\nq0=[0.99981,-0.01018,0.01423,-0.00878]\nR0=quat_to_R(q0);p0=np.array([1.52675,0.36123,0.28234])\ncenterA=A.mean(0)\n\ndef rnd():\n    # bias toward moving away in +x/+y/-y and rotations\n    p=np.array([np.random.uniform(-1.0,4.0),np.random.uniform(-1.5,2.5),np.random.uniform(-1.0,1.5)])\n    R=Rot.random().as_matrix()\n    return R,p\n\n# store as arrays of R (3x3) and p, plus parent, and a \"state vector\" for fast nearest\nRs=[R0];ps=[p0];par=[-1]\nSP=np.array([[0,0,0]])  # dummy\n# state vector: [rx,ry,rz (rotvec), x,y,z] for nearest metric\ndef sv(R,p):\n    return np.concatenate([Rot.from_matrix(R).as_rotvec(),p])\nSV=sv(R0,p0)[None,:]\nstep_p=0.12; step_r=0.25\ngoal_idx=None\nt0=time.time()\nfor it in range(maxit):\n    R,p=rnd()\n    q=sv(R,p)\n    # nearest by weighted dist\n    diff=SV-q\n    diff[:,:3]*=0.5\n    d=np.linalg.norm(diff,axis=1)\n    bi=int(np.argmin(d))\n    Rn,pn=Rs[bi],ps[bi]\n    # steer\n    dp=p-pn; rv=(Rot.from_matrix(Rn).inv()*Rot.from_matrix(R)).as_rotvec()\n    sc=1.0\n    npn=np.linalg.norm(dp); na=np.linalg.norm(rv)\n    if npn>step_p: sc=min(sc,step_p/npn)\n    if na>step_r: sc=min(sc,step_r/na)\n    np_=pn+dp*sc\n    Rn_=(Rot.from_matrix(Rn)*Rot.from_rotvec(rv*sc)).as_matrix()\n    # collision check along edge\n    ok=True\n    for k in range(1,6):\n        a=k/5\n        Rk=Rot.from_matrix(Rn)*Rot.from_rotvec(rv*sc*a)\n        pk=pn+dp*sc*a\n        if clearance_sym(Rk.as_matrix(),pk)<=CLEAR: ok=False;break\n    if not ok: continue\n    Rs.append(Rn_);ps.append(np_);par.append(bi)\n    SV=np.vstack([SV,sv(Rn_,np_)])\n    if np.linalg.norm(np_-centerA)>3.0:\n        goal_idx=len(Rs)-1;break\n    if it%2000==0:\n        print(it,len(Rs),\"%.1fs\"%(time.time()-t0),flush=True)\nprint(\"END it\",it,\"n\",len(Rs),\"goal\",goal_idx,flush=True)\nwith open(f\"tree{seed}.pkl\",\"wb\") as f:\n    pickle.dump({\"Rs\":Rs,\"ps\":ps,\"par\":par,\"goal\":goal_idx},f)\nEOF\nnohup python3 planner2.py 0 30000 > rrt0.log 2>&1 &\nsleep 30 && cat rrt0.log"},"output":"(no output)","metadata":{"output":"(no output)","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"cd /app && cat > planner2.py <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np, pickle, sys, time\nfrom model2 import *\nfrom scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot\nseed=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0\nmaxit=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 20000\nnp.random.seed(seed)\nCLEAR=0.008\n\nq0=[0.99981,-0.01018,0.01423,-0.00878]\nR0=quat_to_R(q0);p0=np.array([1.52675,0.36123,0.28234])\ncenterA=A.mean(0)\n\ndef rnd():\n    # bias toward moving away in +x/+y/-y and rotations\n    p=np.array([np.random.uniform(-1.0,4.0),np.random.uniform(-1.5,2.5),np.random.uniform(-1.0,1.5)])\n    R=Rot.random().as_matrix()\n    return R,p\n\n# store as arrays of R (3x3) and p, plus parent, and a \"state vector\" for fast nearest\nRs=[R0];ps=[p0];par=[-1]\nSP=np.array([[0,0,0]])  # dummy\n# state vector: [rx,ry,rz (rotvec), x,y,z] for nearest metric\ndef sv(R,p):\n    return np.concatenate([Rot.from_matrix(R).as_rotvec(),p])\nSV=sv(R0,p0)[None,:]\nstep_p=0.12; step_r=0.25\ngoal_idx=None\nt0=time.time()\nfor it in range(maxit):\n    R,p=rnd()\n    q=sv(R,p)\n    # nearest by weighted dist\n    diff=SV-q\n    diff[:,:3]*=0.5\n    d=np.linalg.norm(diff,axis=1)\n    bi=int(np.argmin(d))\n    Rn,pn=Rs[bi],ps[bi]\n    # steer\n    dp=p-pn; rv=(Rot.from_matrix(Rn).inv()*Rot.from_matrix(R)).as_rotvec()\n    sc=1.0\n    npn=np.linalg.norm(dp); na=np.linalg.norm(rv)\n    if npn>step_p: sc=min(sc,step_p/npn)\n    if na>step_r: sc=min(sc,step_r/na)\n    np_=pn+dp*sc\n    Rn_=(Rot.from_matrix(Rn)*Rot.from_rotvec(rv*sc)).as_matrix()\n    # collision check along edge\n    ok=True\n    for k in range(1,6):\n        a=k/5\n        Rk=Rot.from_matrix(Rn)*Rot.from_rotvec(rv*sc*a)\n        pk=pn+dp*sc*a\n        if clearance_sym(Rk.as_matrix(),pk)<=CLEAR: ok=False;break\n    if not ok: continue\n    Rs.append(Rn_);ps.append(np_);par.append(bi)\n    SV=np.vstack([SV,sv(Rn_,np_)])\n    if np.linalg.norm(np_-centerA)>3.0:\n        goal_idx=len(Rs)-1;break\n    if it%2000==0:\n        print(it,len(Rs),\"%.1fs\"%(time.time()-t0),flush=True)\nprint(\"END it\",it,\"n\",len(Rs),\"goal\",goal_idx,flush=True)\nwith open(f\"tree{seed}.pkl\",\"wb\") as f:\n    pickle.dump({\"Rs\":Rs,\"ps\":ps,\"par\":par,\"goal\":goal_idx},f)\nEOF\nnohup python3 planner2.py 0 30000 > rrt0.log 2>&1 &\nsleep 30 && cat rrt0.log","time":{"start":1794680053589,"end":1794680083631}},"id":"prt_1db445f47001oLkkpNeyCdn6Nr","sessionID":"ses_e24c0f8d0ffecanHQfvxrHQzsR","messageID":"msg_1db4455d8001oDZfoiAZ27nn5q"}}
